description: Self-contained Salesforce REST API workhorse. Two auth modes: OAuth 2.0 password grant or OAuth 2.0 JWT Bearer (SF-recommended for new orgs). Retry on 401 (token refresh) / 429 / 5xx. Convenience methods for read (soql cursor, describe_sobject, get_record, find_record) + write (create_record, update_record, upsert_record via native External-ID, composite_upsert, bulk_upsert via Bulk 2.0 async API, delete_record).

outputs.description: SalesforceResource with read + write convenience methods. Consumed by salesforce_record_upsert (sink) and by custom Dagster asset code that needs SOQL / SObject CRUD.

auth_mode.label: Auth Mode
auth_mode.description: 'password' (legacy but universal) or 'jwt_bearer' (modern headless; SF-recommended for new orgs). Field requirements differ per mode.

consumer_key_env_var.label: Consumer Key Env Var
consumer_key_env_var.description: From Setup → App Manager → Connected App. Required for both auth modes.

consumer_secret_env_var.label: Consumer Secret Env Var
consumer_secret_env_var.description: Required when auth_mode='password'. Not used for JWT Bearer.

security_token_env_var.label: Security Token Env Var
security_token_env_var.description: Optional (password mode only). Appended to password at auth time — required for IP-restricted orgs.

private_key_pem_env_var.label: Private Key PEM Env Var
private_key_pem_env_var.description: Env var holding the RSA private key PEM content (full BEGIN/END block). Required when auth_mode='jwt_bearer'. Matching cert must be uploaded under Connected App → Digital Certificates.

jwt_subject.label: JWT Subject
jwt_subject.description: JWT `sub` claim — Salesforce user the assertion authorizes as. Defaults to `username`. JWT Bearer mode only.

jwt_audience.label: JWT Audience
jwt_audience.description: JWT `aud` claim — SF token endpoint host. Defaults to `https://{domain}.salesforce.com`. JWT Bearer mode only.

name: Salesforce Resource
